name: skipping-counter
description: Counts jump-rope skips through the phone camera, on the device.

scripts.serve: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 8000 --directory www
scripts.ios:setup: npm run build && npx cap add ios && bash scripts/ios-setup.sh
scripts.ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
